newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD employees can buy shares at discount.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD employees can buy shares at discount.

text.p: Employees of Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) will be able to buy CVRD shares at a 50 or 60 percent discount when the firm is privatized, a National Development Bank (BNDES) official said.
Under the privatization rules, CVRD employees can acquire 4.45 percent of ordinary shares and six percent of preference shares.

BNDES privatization chief Jose Pio Borges said employees who opted to buy shares in the Valecom holding, which consists of the controling stake of 40-45 percent of CVRD voting shares, would receive a 50 percent discount.
Employees who decide to buy CVRD shares outside the controlling block would receive a 60 percent discount, he said.
CVRD employees will have to make their preference known before the company's privatization auction, Borges said.
He said the tender documents for the initial sell-off of the 40-45 percent controlling stake would be published at the latest by March 7, but possibly by the end of February.
The privatization auction should take place 45 days after publication of the tender documents.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
